name: foodbridge
description: FoodBridge - Zero Waste, Zero Hunger Logistics Platform (React + Node.js + Express + Prisma + MySQL)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend

author: FoodBridge Team
